name: Countess Tabitha
source:
An exceptional alchemist and ex-girlfriend of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Their breakup was brutal for the MC. She has since married an Earl. While with the prince, she drugged his [url=https://vndb.org/c165638]brother[/url] and took him to bed. The MC caught her with his brother and ended their relationship. So many rumours abound about Tabitha no one knows what is true anymore.
